Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm writing to apply for the Content Enablement & Acceleration Specialist role at SD Worx. I've built and launched around 600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association, and I've structured content for a trilingual site (English, Dutch, French) from scratch. That hands-on experience with content structuring, governance and reuse is exactly what your Content Repository rollout needs.

At Episto and as a freelancer, I work with content owners and stakeholders to prepare, enrich and publish content across channels. I use AI and automation daily to speed up content preparation and reuse, and I'm comfortable coordinating with different departments and markets. I have my own car, so working from your Antwerp office is no problem.

I'd love to talk about how I can help accelerate your content ecosystem.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

When I built around 600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association, I saw firsthand how structured content makes life easier for everyone who touches it. That's why the Content Enablement & Acceleration Specialist role at SD Worx caught my attention: your focus on rolling out a Content Repository and making content reusable across markets is exactly the kind of hands-on, collaborative work I enjoy.

At Episto, I run keyword research, local and mobile SEO, and link building for clients in consulting, auto and e-commerce. I also support a WooCommerce webshop with catalogue, product content and conversion pages. As a freelancer, I sell AI search visibility, SEO and marketing automation services, and I use AI tools daily to accelerate content preparation and reuse. For a kids' bike brand, I built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and ran a self-funded Google Ads test that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks. I presented the results to their team, which taught me how to translate content and operational needs into clear requirements.

What draws me to SD Worx is your purpose of bringing people solutions to life across Europe. I've built a trilingual site (English, Dutch, French) single-handedly, so I understand the challenges of localisation and structured content. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Antwerp office is no problem.

In the first weeks, I would map the priority markets' content needs, identify quick wins for the Content Repository onboarding, and start capturing rollout learnings into repeatable guidelines. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your content ecosystem. Let's talk.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

# Baver Ok
Content structuring · AI & automation · SEO & GEO · WordPress

English (fluent) · Turkish (native) · Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+)

## SUMMARY
I bring hands-on experience preparing, structuring and enriching content for digital publication, with a focus on reuse and scalability. At Episto I run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients, and I support a WooCommerce webshop with catalogue, product content and conversion pages. As a freelancer I sell AI search visibility, SEO and marketing automation services, using a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation. I build my own products with AI, from a dog-care app on Google Play to fitness trackers, which keeps me close to how real users find, try and stick with a product. I am analytical, I follow search engine algorithm updates closely, and I am eager to learn.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- Support a WooCommerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results
- **~600 member profile pages** built and launched on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present
- Sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services, with a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation
- **4.57% CTR and 53 clicks** from a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands for a kids' bike brand: built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team
- Brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering the website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026
- Built [kxp.be](https://kxp.be) single-handedly: WordPress, on-page SEO, GEO for AI search, in English, Dutch and French
- Delivered client websites end to end, from site structure and content to social media integration
- **#3 on Google** for "Belgian chess prodigy" with [mirook.com](https://mirook.com), a young chess player's personal-brand site, through technical SEO audits and schema markup
- Analysed SEO performance and reported results to clients with Search Console and Google Analytics

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

### AI job-search assistant
- Built an AI tool that collects job postings from VDAB, LinkedIn and EURES, scores each one for fit and drafts a tailored CV and cover letter, as a working example of marketing automation

### Rebound – personal fitness app
- Built a fitness app that logs every workout and syncs data from a smartwatch and smart scale, turning steps, calories and body stats into clear progress graphs
- Developed and deployed it solo with AI coding tools (Claude Code), shipping features as soon as needed

## SKILLS
- **SEO & marketing:** AI search (GEO/AEO), content marketing, SEO strategy, keyword research, on-page, technical, local and mobile SEO, link building, SEO audits, schema markup, Google Ads Search, WooCommerce
- **Data & tools:** WordPress/Elementor, GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, HTML/CSS, Odoo, Canva, Claude/ChatGPT
- **Growth & sales:** lead generation, landing pages, client discovery meetings, offers and proposals, A/B testing

## EDUCATION
- Applied Computer Science (coursework) – Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp, 2022 – 2025
- Computer Science (coursework) – Celal Bayar University, Türkiye, 2012 – 2016
